caveats: E2 is an open-data imputation, not measured inventory. The nine E2 provinces have no local taper, DBH distribution, defect, grade or component-weight measurement.
Branch and foliage are CFS model estimates, not measured component weights. They are never added to stem taper volume.
Panel and pellet/bio splits and class conversion ratios remain donor assumptions and are not provincial product coefficients.
0.35/0.60/0.75 recovery values are scenarios with equal status; 0.60 is a reference, not a calibrated recovery factor.
No national supply, official grade, policy, operating or investment claim is made. No UI or official OSeCAN surface is changed.

E2c density calibration is extensive: it changes the expanded reference volume and density evidence, not the per-m3 product or residue coefficients. v5 fixed-harvest products and residue therefore equal v4.
Only SK, NS and PE have an open inventory volume check. AB, MB, ON, NL, NT and NU are not_available, not passes; MB density is donor evidence.

e2_v2_vs_e2c_coefficients.explanation: E2 v2 and E2c v3 share per-m3 product shares and residue coefficients; density calibration changes expansion and the expanded reference volume only.

method.density_calibration: E2c uses province-specific open-inventory stem density where available, donor median density for MB, and a labelled 1,000 stems/ha proxy for AB/ON/NL/NT/NU
method.donor_assumptions: within-class SAW/PANEL and PELLET/BIO splits, class product and process-residue ratios, stem-residue m3 routing share
method.harvest_residue: E1 measured and E2 imputed stem + CFS branch + foliage gross residue; 0.35/0.60/0.75 scenarios with 0.60 reference
method.product_coefficients: E1 measured and E2c density-calibrated provincial solid/pulp/other shares; no donor provincial product coefficient

residue_components.scope: E1 measured + E2c density-calibrated stem + CFS branch/foliage total residue

scope: 13-jurisdiction product and total-residue chain; E1 measured for BC/QC/NB/YT and E2c density-calibrated for AB/SK/MB/ON/NS/PE/NL/NT/NU

v3_2_vs_v4.explanation: v3.2 uses the E2 v1 product coefficients, not E2 v2. The v4 chain replaces them with E2c v3. Differences are E2 v1 to E2c coefficient effects at fixed assignment and harvest.

checks.detail: stem + branch/foliage = total; scenarios = gross * factor
all numeric fields finite and nonnegative
4 E1 measured + 9 E2c density-calibrated; 0 donor product shares
all nine E2c rows carry density evidence and calibration status
v3.2 (E2 v1) to v4 (E2c) product and residue deltas are reported per province and metric
E2 v2 and E2c per-m3 coefficients are unchanged
